title: SCRABBLE CHAPIONSHIP 20206 - ALL INDIA SCHOOL
summary: On Sunday 18th October the Scrabble Championship 2026 for All India Schools was held from 9.00 am to 4.00 pm at Jamnabhai Narsee School, Juhu, Mumbai.
description: On Sunday 18th October the Scrabble Championship 2026 for All India Schools was held from 9.00 am to 4.00 pm at Jamnabhai Narsee School, Juhu, Mumbai. The event was hosted by the Rotary Club of Bombay Harbour and sponsored by Rtn. Badri Prasad Choudhury. A total 122 students from 22 schools participated in the championship. The competition was conducted in two categories. Junior Division - Students of Standards V & VI and Senior Division - students of Standards VII & VIII. At the conclusion of the competition, prizes and certificate were awarded to top two winners in each division in recognition of their performance anbd achievement. From Rotary Club of Bombay Harbour -Rtn. Jaipal Shah (President), Rtn. Badri Prasad Choudhury (Project Sponsor), Rtn. Shefali Shah, Rtn. Keyur Bharat Purohit. From Rotary Club of Bombay East Rtn. Rama Patel was also attended.
location: Jamnabai Narsee School, Juhu, Mumbai - 400049, Maharashtra
